notes: Announced 20 Mar 2018: Bitfury opened an energy-efficient bitcoin-mining data center on two sites in Mo Industripark, Mo i Rana, ~USD 35M (NOK 274M) investment, ~30 jobs; initial server farm ~42 MW on 100% renewable power. Hailed as Norway's largest data center at the time; current operational status not re-verified in this pass.
